claim: OmniView turns a natural place-time request into a grounded optic, material scene, complete positive Render Seed, and truthful render state while preserving temporal precision, camera support, habitation, evidence, scenario, comparison, attribution, and external-authority boundaries.
criteria: Places the optic on or explicitly just above ice.
Builds the view from ice-sheet surface, snow, wind, cloud, crevasse or stress geometry, light, and scale while labeling local detail as bounded inference.
Keeps source metadata in the grounding note and translates it into visible ice support.
acceptable_variation: May choose a physical ice footing or a virtual aperture at a declared height.
failure_signals: Places the camera on a lateral moraine, lake shore, forest floor, or exposed boulder field
Presents exact weather or surface topography as source-observed
Pastes dataset language into the Render Seed
synthesis: Every indispensable dimension must appear across the suite. Any fabricated famous event, unsupported footing, unearned person or structure, leaked evaluator contradiction, false render claim, hidden future scenario, or official-GL4SS impersonation defeats the behavioral claim.
